title: Reading a Bone X-ray — A Safe Routine for Fractures and Joints

hook.en: An X-ray report can decide whether you treat, refer or wait. Learn what a plain X-ray shows, a simple routine to look at one, and what you can and cannot say as a physiotherapist.
hook.ur: X-ray report faisla karti hai ke aap ilaj karein, refer karein ya intezaar. Seekhein saada X-ray kya dikhata hai, use dekhne ki saadi routine, aur physiotherapist ke taur par aap kya keh sakte hain aur kya nahi.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what an X-ray shows, use an ABCS routine to look at a bone X-ray, read the words in a report (fracture, displacement, joint space, osteophyte) and know when a normal X-ray still needs follow-up.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke X-ray kya dikhata hai, hadi X-ray dekhne ke liye ABCS routine istemal karenge, report ke alfaz (fracture, displacement, joint space, osteophyte) parhenge aur jaanenge ke normal X-ray ke baad bhi follow-up kab chahiye.

text.en: An **X-ray** passes radiation through the body. **Dense tissue (bone) blocks more and looks white; air looks black; soft tissue is grey.** One picture flattens a three-dimensional bone, so we **always want two views at right angles** (for example front and side). Reading X-rays for a diagnosis is the radiologist's or doctor's job; the physiotherapist's aim is to **understand the report, check it against the patient and act safely**.
text.ur: **X-ray** jism se radiation guzarta hai. **Ghani tissue (haddi) zyada rokti hai aur safed nazar aati hai; hawa kaali; narm tissue bhoora.** Ek tasveer teen-dimensional haddi ko chapta kar deti hai, is liye hum **hamesha seedhe zaviye par do views** chahte hain (maslan samne aur side). Tashkhees ke liye X-ray parhna radiologist ya doctor ka kaam hai; physiotherapist ka maqsad **report samajhna, usay mareez se milana aur mehfooz kaarwai karna** hai.

text.en: Think of an X-ray as **a shadow puppet show**. A single shadow can hide a bend or a crack that shows only from another angle. That is why we turn the hand and look again, which is what the second view does. And a shadow cannot show colour or soft detail: it shows density only.
text.ur: X-ray ko **parchhaiyon ka khel** samjhein. Ek parchhai aisi mor ya dararh chhupa sakti hai jo kisi aur zaviye se nazar aati hai. Isi liye hum hath ghuma kar dobara dekhte hain, jo doosra view karta hai. Aur parchhai rang ya narm tafseel nahi dikha sakti: yeh sirf density dikhati hai.

title.en: A routine for looking at a bone X-ray

steps.title: Check the picture
steps.detail: Read the patient's name, date and side marker, and make sure there are two views that include the joint above and below. A poor picture can hide a fracture. || Tasveer check karein

steps.title: A for alignment
steps.detail: Follow the outline of the bones and check that they line up: joints should meet in a smooth line, with no step or gap. Look for dislocation. || A matlab alignment

steps.title: B for bones
steps.detail: Follow the outer edge (cortex) of each bone like a pencil line. Look for a break in the line, a step, a lucent (dark) line through the bone or a ring of new bone. Check the whole bone, not only the sore spot. || B matlab bones

steps.title: C and S for cartilage space and soft tissue
steps.detail: Look at the joint space (a narrow space means loss of cartilage) and the soft tissue (swelling, or a fat pad lifted by fluid inside the elbow, can be the only sign of a hidden fracture). || C aur S matlab cartilage space aur soft tissue

question.en: What does a white area on an X-ray usually mean?
question.ur: X-ray par safed hissa aam taur par kya batata hai?

text.en: Dense tissue such as bone or metal
text.ur: Ghani tissue maslan haddi ya dhaat

feedback.en: Yes — dense materials block more radiation.
feedback.ur: Haan — ghani cheezein zyada radiation rokti hain.

title.en: What a plain X-ray shows well and badly
title.ur: Saada X-ray kya achha aur kya kamzor dikhata hai

rows.en: Bone, dislocations, metal implants, some joint space loss
rows.ur: Haddi, dislocations, dhaat ke implants, kuch joint space ka kam hona

rows.en: Ligament, tendon, muscle, cartilage, nerve, disc
rows.ur: Ligament, tendon, muscle, cartilage, nerve, disc

rows.en: Stress fractures and some scaphoid or hip fractures in the first days
rows.ur: Stress fractures aur pehle dino mein kuch scaphoid ya hip fractures

rows.en: Needs another test (MRI or CT) if suspicion remains
rows.ur: Shak baqi ho to doosra test (MRI ya CT) chahiye

rows.en: Low dose, avoid in pregnancy unless essential
rows.ur: Kam dose, hamal mein zaroorat ke baghair na karwayein

text.en: **Two views, two joints, all the bone.** Ask for at least two views, include the joint above and below, and follow the whole outline of every bone. A normal X-ray does not exclude a fracture if the story fits one.
text.ur: **Do views, do joints, poori haddi.** Kam az kam do views, oopar aur neeche ka joint, aur har haddi ka poora khaka dekhein. Kahani fracture se milti ho to normal X-ray fracture rule out nahi karta.

text.en: **Treating the picture and forgetting the patient.** Many X-ray changes, such as joint space narrowing or bone spurs, are common in people with no pain, and an X-ray can look normal in a painful joint. Treat the person's pain, function and examination, and use the X-ray as one piece of the picture.
text.ur: **Tasveer ka ilaj aur mareez ko bhool jana.** X-ray ki bohat si tabdeeliyan, maslan joint space ka kam hona ya haddi ke ubhaar, bina dard wale logon mein aam hain, aur dardnak joint ka X-ray normal ho sakta hai. Mareez ke dard, function aur examination ka ilaj karein aur X-ray ko tasveer ka ek hissa samjhein.

question.en: A patient has a painful wrist after a fall and a normal X-ray, but tenderness in the anatomical snuffbox. What should you do?
question.ur: Girne ke baad kalai dardnak hai aur X-ray normal hai, magar anatomical snuffbox mein tenderness hai. Aap kya karein?

text.en: Reassure that the wrist is fine and discharge
text.ur: Tasalli dein ke kalai theek hai aur chhutti dein

feedback.en: A normal X-ray does not exclude this fracture.
feedback.ur: Normal X-ray is fracture ko rule out nahi karta.

text.en: Treat as a possible scaphoid fracture: protect and refer for repeat imaging or an MRI or CT
text.ur: Mumkin scaphoid fracture samajh kar hifazat karein aur dobara imaging ya MRI ya CT ke liye refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — scaphoid fractures can be invisible on the first X-ray.
feedback.ur: Haan — scaphoid fracture pehle X-ray par nazar na aaye yeh mumkin hai.

text.en: Start strong wrist loading at once
text.ur: Kalai par foran sakht load shuru karein

feedback.ur: Isse fracture ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.

question.en: In a child, why is a "line" across the end of a long bone not always a fracture?
question.ur: Bachay mein lambi haddi ke sire par "line" hamesha fracture kyun nahi hoti?

text.en: It may be the growth plate, which is normal in children and needs comparison with the other side
text.ur: Yeh growth plate ho sakti hai jo bachon mein normal hai aur doosri side se muqabla chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — but a growth plate injury is also possible, so the doctor decides.
feedback.ur: Haan — magar growth plate ki chot bhi mumkin hai, is liye doctor faisla karta hai.

feedback.en: Growth plates look like lines in children.
feedback.ur: Bachon mein growth plates line ki tarah dikhti hain.

text.en: **Say what the report means in plain words.** For example: "The X-ray shows a small bone spur and some narrowing of the joint space. This is common with age and does not mean the knee is damaged beyond help. Your pain depends on how the knee works, so we will strengthen it." Avoid frightening phrases such as "bone on bone" unless the report says it and explain that treatment is still exercise.
text.ur: **Report ka matlab saade alfaz mein batayein.** Maslan: "X-ray mein chhota haddi ka ubhaar aur joint space thora tang hai. Yeh umar ke saath aam hai aur iska matlab nahi ke knee ka ilaj nahi ho sakta. Aap ka dard is par munhasir hai ke knee kaise kaam karti hai, is liye hum isay mazboot karenge." "Bone on bone" jaise daraune jumlon se bachein jab tak report na kahe, aur samjhayein ke ilaj phir bhi exercise hai.

question.en: Why can a normal X-ray not rule out a stress fracture or scaphoid fracture early on?
question.ur: Normal X-ray shuruaat mein stress fracture ya scaphoid fracture rule out kyun nahi kar sakta?

answer.en: Early cracks may be too fine to change the bone's density on a flat picture, and the bone reaction that makes them visible takes days to weeks. If the history and examination fit a fracture, protect the area and use repeat imaging, MRI or CT.
answer.ur: Shuruati dararein itni baareek ho sakti hain ke chapti tasveer par haddi ki density na badlein, aur woh haddi ka reaction jo unhein nazar aane ke qabil banata hai din se haftay leta hai. Kahani aur examination fracture se milti hon to hissay ko bachayein aur dobara imaging, MRI ya CT istemal karein.

beats.patient: A 17-year-old runner has a week of pain in the front of the shin that worsens with running and now hurts at night. The X-ray is reported normal. He has focal tenderness over one spot on the tibia.
beats.assessment: Pain at one bone point, night pain and a rising load fit a tibial stress fracture, which is often not yet visible on X-ray.
beats.treatment: Stop running, protect, and refer for an MRI, and plan load, nutrition and bone health review.
beats.reassess: The MRI shows a stress reaction; after rest and a graded return he is back to running in two months.

text.en: **Never delay referral because an X-ray is normal.** Refer urgently for a possible fracture with deformity, inability to bear weight, numbness or a pale cold limb, severe pain after a fall in an older person or someone with osteoporosis (possible hip fracture), a child with a limp and fever, or bone pain with unexplained weight loss. Avoid unnecessary X-rays in pregnancy, and decide imaging with the doctor.
text.ur: **X-ray normal hone par bhi referral mein takheer na karein.** Mumkin fracture, bad-shakli, wazan na utha pane, sunn hona ya zard thande ang, buzurg ya osteoporosis wale mein girne ke baad shadeed dard (mumkin hip fracture), bukhar ke saath langrate bachay, ya be-wajah wazan ke girne ke saath haddi ke dard par foran refer karein. Hamal mein ghair zaroori X-rays se bachein, aur imaging ka faisla doctor ke saath karein.

summary.en: An X-ray shows density: bone is white, air black and soft tissue grey; always ask for two views including the joint above and below.
summary.ur: X-ray density dikhata hai: haddi safed, hawa kaali, narm tissue bhoora; hamesha do views mangein jin mein oopar aur neeche ka joint ho.

summary.en: Use ABCS: alignment, bones (follow every outline), cartilage space and soft tissue; a normal film does not rule out an early stress or scaphoid fracture.
summary.ur: ABCS istemal karein: alignment, bones (har khaka follow karein), cartilage space aur soft tissue; normal film shuruati stress ya scaphoid fracture rule out nahi karti.

summary.en: Explain reports in plain words, treat the patient rather than the picture, and refer urgently for red flags whatever the film shows.
summary.ur: Reports saade alfaz mein samjhayein, tasveer nahi mareez ka ilaj karein, aur red flags par film kuch bhi ho foran refer karein.
